topics.title: A circle and a line in a plane

concepts.learning_objective: Classify a line as non-intersecting, secant or tangent by the number of points it shares with a circle.
State the meaning of a secant and a tangent to a circle and recognise them in real situations.

topics.title: Tangent to a circle and its existence

concepts.learning_objective: Describe a tangent, its point of contact and how many tangents a circle can have.
Explain a tangent as the limiting position of a secant when the two ends of its chord coincide.
Reason that at most two tangents to a circle can be parallel to a given secant or line.
Use the fact that the tangent at a point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.
Calculate lengths in the right triangle formed by a radius, a tangent and the line joining the centre to an external point.

topics.title: Number of tangents from a point and length of a tangent

concepts.learning_objective: State how many tangents pass through a point inside, on or outside a circle.
Define and calculate the length of the tangent from an external point to a circle.

topics.title: Equal tangents from an external point (Theorem 10.2)

concepts.learning_objective: Prove and use the fact that the two tangents from an external point to a circle are equal in length.
Find angles formed by two tangents from an external point, the radii and the chord of contact.

topics.title: Applications: concentric circles and circumscribed figures

concepts.learning_objective: Find the chord of the larger of two concentric circles that touches the smaller circle.
Use equal tangents to relate the sides of a quadrilateral circumscribing a circle.
Find the sides of a triangle circumscribing a circle using equal tangent lengths and areas.
